method: exact percentile bootstrap over passes, 6**6 = 46656 resamples enumerated; outer simulation 100000 replicates, seed 20261006; paired log-ratio interval for the reference-vs-opponent pair and a single-row median interval for reference
generator: Python random.Random (Mersenne Twister), outer simulation only
interval: type-7 linear-interpolation percentile of the bootstrap median, 2.5/97.5 for the raw 95% interval and alpha/2 for the adjusted interval
releaseReads: the release verdict embeds this document verbatim under coverage; tables.release.md prints it in the Coverage section; it is not a thresholds key

loss.lossRate.reason: degenerate calibration values (all zero or non-positive); the percentile interval is zero-width and the release state is unevaluable, never same

lat.tcp_rtt.p50.reason: B 0.23769975467369542 > B_business 0.05; demoted by the pre-registered rule; the analyzer reports the metric as exploratory with values and raw CI only and makes no decision

cpu.proxy.vcpuPct.reason: B 0.12683221015296758 > B_business 0.10; demoted by the pre-registered rule; the analyzer reports the metric as exploratory with values and raw CI only and makes no decision

validation.method: the same exact-6**n enumeration at n=3 and n=4 reproduces the design-review coverage bands

limits: The simulation models pass-level log-normal noise with sigma estimated from the three calibration values; it is not a resampling of those three values themselves.
The reference-vs-opponent pair is simulated with independent equal-sigma rows; the calibration has no opponent row, so the ratio noise is an assumption, not a measured quantity.
The loss interval is degenerate at the calibration values and is not simulated; the release state is unevaluable, never same.
The coverage is the method-level coverage at n=6; it is not a prediction for a particular opponent or a confidence statement about the B9 campaign.
Latency p50 and CPU are demoted to exploratory; their simulated coverage is recorded for context only and is not used by the release decision.
